# TweetDetail test fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic, redacted structural samples. They contain no
cookies, tokens, request headers, or copied private response data.

They verify xFlow's focal-id selection and compatibility with its existing
media/quote parsers. They are not evidence that every shape matches the live X
TweetDetail API; live ordinary, photo, video, quote, long-text, and visibility
wrapper responses remain unverified until separately captured and redacted
under an authorized account and available quota.
